=== 🚀 Quick start
[b]繁體中文版：[/b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3817840347]小地圖 - MOD 地圖擴充 完整說明[/url]

The mod on Steam Workshop:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3763914102
[h3]What you need[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Required[/b]: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3763913359]Minidoracat MiniMap[/url] (main mod) and its requirement [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3789836701]Minidoracat UI Library[/url].
[*] [b]The map mods you want to play[/b]: this pack only provides images and data, so the maps themselves must be subscribed separately.
[*] [b]Add/remove mid-save[/b]: safe either way.
[*] [b]Languages[/b]: 繁體中文, 简体中文, English, 日本語, 한국어, Русский, Español, Português, Türkçe, Français, Polski, Deutsch (please report any translation issues).
[/list]
Keep every Minidoracat MiniMap series mod up to date and restart the game after updating.
[h3]Getting started[/h3]
[olist]
[*] [b]Subscribe[/b]: the main mod and this pack.
[*] [b]Pick maps[/b]: choose map mods from the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3766382352]supported maps collection[/url], then subscribe and enable them.
[*] [b]In game[/b]: press [b]/[/b] for the minimap or [b]M[/b] for the world map; the map area shows its image, outline and name.
[/olist]
{{img:mod-map-outlines.jpg}}
=== 🧰 Supported maps (A–M)
96 map mods, 128 maps. To subscribe to them all at once, use the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3766382352]supported maps collection[/url].
[list]
[*] [b]✅[/b]: the author ships road data: street names, search and navigation work (number = street count).
[*] [b]🛠️[/b]: road data fixed or added by this pack; see "Roads fixed or added by this pack".
[*] [b]No mark[/b]: map image only, no street names, search or navigation.
[/list]

=== 🧰 Roads fixed or added by this pack
[list]
[*] [b]Constown, KY[/b]: the author ships no road data, so this pack adds 38 roads; they are searchable and routable.
[list]
[*] They are named like "Constown Rd 01 (MiniMap)".
[*] The game switches to the author's roads automatically if the author adds road data later.
[*] The vanilla Deer Trail Road stretch the map covers (the gravel road north of KY-60) follows the vanilla route with its real 5-tile width, searchable as "Constown Rd 38 (MiniMap)".
[/list]
[*] [b]Bedford Falls[/b]: the author ships no road data, so this pack adds 74 town roads from the author's world map; they are searchable and routable.
[list]
[*] They are named like "Bedford Falls Rd 01 (MiniMap)".
[*] The game switches to the author's roads automatically if the author adds road data later.
[*] The map covers the last roughly 300 tiles of the vanilla KY-60 at its east end; this pack adds them along the vanilla route, searchable as "Bedford Falls Rd 75 (MiniMap)", so you can navigate from KY-60 straight into town.
[*] The two long roads leading north and south out of town are not on the author's world map, so they are not added.
[/list]
[*] [b]Oakshire[/b]: the author ships no road data, so this pack adds 84 town roads from the author's world map; they are searchable and routable.
[list]
[*] They are named like "Oakshire Rd 01 (MiniMap)".
[*] The game switches to the author's roads automatically if the author adds road data later.
[*] The map covers stretches of the vanilla River Walk Road, Riverside Road (two stretches) and Riverside Link Road next to town, which therefore had no navigation data and needed long detours (e.g. a trip of about 1,200 tiles along River Walk Road north of town took about 9,200); this pack adds them along the vanilla routes (roads 01, 42, 76 and 88), so you can navigate into town from outside. One bend of the vanilla Riverside Road was turned into a lake and woods by the author and is not added.
[/list]
[*] [b]Big Bear Lake[/b]: the author marked Lakeview Dr and Deerhead Road wider than the actual road surface, so AutoDrive keeping right ran its wheels into the roadside bushes; they now have their real width. KY-38's line was drawn off to the side of the road (one stretch entirely off the road) and marked too wide, so AutoDrive keeping right often drove off the road; the line now runs down the middle of the road with the real width, and the ends of Standfield Cutoff, Steinbach Rd and Green Valley Lake Dr are extended onto it so they still connect (needs MiniMap 0.47.0 or later). The west part of KY-18 has a median, but the author drew one very wide line, mostly on the north carriageway, so AutoDrive keeping right ran onto the median on one side and into oncoming traffic on the other; it now has one line on the north carriageway, the south carriageway is searchable as "Big Bear Lake Rd 01 (MiniMap)", short links cross the median openings and join the north end of Standfield Cutoff (02–06), and the end of Tofu Rd is extended onto the new line.
[*] [b]Camden County[/b]:
[list]
[*] 3 author roads stopped short of junctions; they now connect, so navigation can reach them.
[*] Brooklawn Blvd is a two-way boulevard with a planted median, but the author marked it one lane wide; it now has its real width, so AutoDrive no longer runs onto the median planters (needs MiniMap 0.47.0 or later).
[/list]
[*] [b]Coryerdon[/b]: the author ships no road data, and the map covers a few stretches of vanilla road, which therefore had no navigation data and needed long detours (e.g. a trip of about 600 tiles along Rock Ridge Road took about 2,300); this pack adds them along the vanilla route, searchable as names like "Coryerdon Rd 01 (MiniMap)".
[list]
[*] Older port: Rock Ridge Road (01) and Crowbar Road (02).
[*] 2026 port: the same two, plus River Walk Road (03), Prewitt Dr (04), Kiss Road (05) and Lipstick Road (06).
[/list]
[*] [b]Daisy County[/b]: 44 roads drawn as outlines are converted to centre lines, so names no longer appear twice.
[*] [b]Dirkerdam[/b]: street names and road data come from Dirkerdam Map Fix; this pack adds and fixes:
[list]
[*] The bridge north of Brandenburg: Map Fix's road stops at its north end, so the roughly 290 tiles to the vanilla stretch of the bridge had no navigation data; this pack adds them along the actual road surface ("Dirkerdam Rd 01 (MiniMap)").
[*] About 55 streets in the south-east (around Lincoln Ave, Beachway Ave and Garfield Ave) were cut off from the main road network at two gaps; this pack adds River Road to Lincoln Ave (Rd 02; the junction is full of junk and leaves only a narrow lane) and Garfield Ave to Mack Dr (Rd 03; about 30 tiles in the middle are bare ground).
[*] Highway 11 (west), Bristol Pike, Beachway Road, Montgomery Ave and the east part of Louise Ave have a tree-lined median, but the author drew a single centre line on the median; they now have one line per carriageway, and the opposite carriageways are searchable as "Dirkerdam Rd 04–08 (MiniMap)".
[*] Two places where the author drew a line doubling back (Stephen Ave, west end of River Road) are cleaned up, so AutoDrive no longer turns around on the spot; Euclid Ave no longer connects to Prospect Ave through the fence at its north end, and the east end of Cedar Ave, a narrow walkway between two fences, no longer connects to Church St; the 5th Ave link to Old Turnpike now passes between the two posts in the junction.
[*] Mauri Ave has a continuous median fence that Main Ave and Cedar Ave are drawn straight through, and Cypress Lane's west end sits on Mauri Ave's tree-lined median; navigation no longer routes through them (the map is drawn as before). Requires the next MiniMap main mod version; older versions behave as before.
[*] 66 roads the author marked wider than the actual road surface now have their real width, so AutoDrive keeping right stays on the road; on US Highway 13, Newport Road and Colonial Dr the author's line was drawn off to one side of the road, and now runs down the middle with the real width (needs MiniMap 0.47.0 or later).
[/list]
[*] [b]JIB Peanut Butter Factory[/b]: the map covers about 300 tiles of the vanilla KY-841 (both carriageways) and One Horse Road in front of the factory, which therefore had no navigation data, so routes along KY-841 took a detour (about 600 tiles became about 1,500); this pack adds them along the vanilla routes, searchable as names like "JIB Peanut Butter Factory Rd 01 (MiniMap)".
[*] [b]Moores Mechanic[/b]: the map covers about 300 tiles of the vanilla Riverside Road in front of the compound, which therefore had no navigation data, so routes along Riverside Road took a long detour (about 700 tiles became about 5,800); this pack adds it along the vanilla route as "Moores Mechanic Rd 01 (MiniMap)". The driveways inside the compound are not added.
[*] [b]Raven Creek[/b]:
[list]
[*] The KY-79 bend where the vanilla highway enters Raven Creek had no navigation data, so routes took a long detour; this pack adds it as "Raven Creek Rd 01 (MiniMap)".
[*] Westbound routes from the east entrance no longer cut through the median trees.
[/list]
[*] [b]Snake's Factory[/b]: the map covers the last roughly 300 tiles of the vanilla KY-60 at its east end, the stretch that leads to the factory, and that stretch had no navigation data, so routes stopped about 300 tiles short of the factory; this pack adds it along the vanilla route, searchable as "Snake's Factory Rd 01 (MiniMap)".
[*] [b]The Walking Dead Prison[/b]: the map covers a stretch each of the vanilla Tioga Road and Magazine Road beside the prison, and those stretches had no navigation data, so routes along Tioga Road took a long detour (about 950 tiles became about 5,300) and could not reach the prison's east gate; this pack adds both along the vanilla route, searchable as "The Walking Dead Prison Rd 01 (MiniMap)" and "The Walking Dead Prison Rd 02 (MiniMap)".
[*] [b]Muldraugh 1993[/b]: 913 street labels that exactly duplicate the vanilla map are hidden on display only; navigation is unaffected.
[/list]
=== ⚠️ Conflicts and overlaps
[list]
[*] [b]Atlanta[/b]: conflicts with Atlanta Tower Survival; choose one.
[*] [b]Foxtrot Warehouse[/b]: fully overlaps Atlanta; choose one.
[*] [b]Raven Creek[/b]: the original and its Kardinal port are either-or.
[*] [b]Willowbrook Bastion[/b]: pick one of the original, its 2026 remake, or the 2026 Map Only version; Map Only shows the 2026 minimap.
[*] [b]Coryerdon[/b]: the older port and the 2026 port (by another author) share the same mod ID; choose one. The minimap shows the matching image based on which map folder the server loads (Coryerdon B42 or Coryerdon).
[*] [b]Nellis Air Force Base[/b]: overlaps Blackpine County and Atlanta; choose one.
[*] [b]Mount Crow City[/b]: mostly overlaps Camden County and slightly overlaps SafeWayHamlet and AnruisiTown; choose one.
[*] [b]DuoDuo City[/b]: overlaps the edge cells of Haven Fall and Nettle Township, and one corner cell each of Tikitown and Trelai 4x4; choose one.
[*] [b]New Hartburg, KY[/b]: lies entirely inside Grapeseed and overlaps Hartburg, KY (the author lists both as conflicts); choose one. It also overlaps edge cells of Constown, Greenleaf, SecretZ Checkpoint 8 and a few others.
[*] [b]Big Bear Lake[/b]: overlaps DuoDuo City, Frogtown, Haven Fall (listed as a conflict by the author) and Macon; choose one. It also partly overlaps Fort Benning, SecretZ North Checkpoint and SecretZ Deerhead Lake Base.
[*] [b]Community Center[/b]: partly overlaps Chinatown, Chinatown Expansion, Fort JadeLake, Muldraugh 1993 and Muldraugh Fire Dept; choose one.
[*] [b]Rosewood Compound[/b]: shares one cell with Fort Preston and Taibei Road; choose one.
[*] [b]The Walking Dead Prison[/b]: partly overlaps VaultTec Road (including the north side of the prison), SecretZ Train Depot Refugee Camp and VaultTec Vault - Muldraugh; choose one.
[*] [b]Dirkerdam[/b]: overlaps two cells of Riverside Mansion (Unofficial); choose one. A few cells of Floatopia and Riverside Mansion also lie inside Dirkerdam's bounds; when used together, the minimap image of those cells comes from whichever map is listed first in the server map order (Map=). Street names, search and navigation come from Dirkerdam Map Fix; without it you only get the map image, plus the 7 roads this pack adds.
[*] [b]Snake's ModPack Build 42[/b]: the author currently supports single player only. Military Complex lies entirely inside DuoDuo City; SnakeVille fully overlaps both versions of Hunter's Base and partly overlaps Tikitown, SecretZ Checkpoint 6 and SecretZ Riverside Checkpoint 2; Factory fully overlaps SafeWayHamlet and partly overlaps AnruisiTown, Camden County and Safeharbor Garrison; Numark Complex partly overlaps Blackmaze, Snake Mansion partly overlaps Ashenwood, Muldraugh 1993 and SecretZ Checkpoint 5, Barco Abandonado partly overlaps West Point Expansion, the Louisville auto shop shares a cell with SecretZ Louisville Military Complex and VaultTec Vault - Louisville, and the March Ridge auto shop shares a cell with Atlas Underground Complex and SecretZ March Ridge Research Facility; choose one. The two SnakeVille sites overlap each other by two cells; whichever is listed first in the map order wins.
[*] [b]Bedford Falls[/b]: most of its cells overlap Camden County, and it partly overlaps Mount Crow City, Nekomata Ridge, AnruisiTown, Atlanta, SafeWayHamlet, Safeharbor Garrison, Snake's Factory, West Point Expansion, SecretZ Checkpoint 1 and VaultTec Vault - Muldraugh; choose one. The two western columns of its bounds (x 12032–12544) are mostly not part of the map, and the minimap shows vanilla imagery there: when using it with The Walking Dead Prison, Begonia Town or VaultTec Road, list Bedford Falls after them in the server map order (Map=) so those cells show their images.
[*] [b]Oakshire[/b]: partly overlaps Atlanta Safe Zone, Greenport, Ed's Auto Salvage, LittleTownship and Maplewood; choose one.
[*] [b]Moores Mechanic[/b]: overlaps one cell of Chinatown Expansion and two cells of Erika's Furniture Store; choose one. The compound spans these cells, so whichever map comes later in the server map order (Map=) loses its part of the shared cells. Chinatown only borders it and does not overlap.
[*] [b]Atlas Underground Complex[/b]: surface imagery only (no underground floors); it partly overlaps several nearby maps, and using them together is not guaranteed.
[/list]
=== ❓ FAQ
[h3]Do I need the original map mod?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Yes. This pack only shows a map's image while that map mod is enabled.
[/list]
[h3]Why do some maps have no street names or navigation?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Maps without ✅ have no road data from the author.
[*] Where maps overlap, covered road sections may also be missing from search (in multiplayer, the server's map order decides).
[*] Details: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3817841972]MiniMap Guide[/url]
[/list]
[h3]Can I turn off the outlines or map images?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Yes, in the minimap gear settings or the ESC mod options.
[*] The outline colour can be changed too.
[/list]
